name: Push Press
instructions: Set a barbell at shoulder height in a rack and grip it just outside your shoulders. Lift it out and hold it across your upper chest and front shoulders, with your elbows slightly in front of the bar and your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Immediately drive up through your heels and press the bar overhead, using the momentum from your legs to help lift it. Lock out your arms with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, bending your knees slightly to absorb the weight.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
